summary: Days Gone entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Days Gone
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with Broken Road DLC state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC or PlayStation hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with DLC and settings documented

primary.version: Current PC release with Broken Road DLC if owned
primary.why: The PC version is the best capture route and gained parity with the remastered feature set through the Broken Road DLC path on PC. The PS5 Remastered route is useful for console comparison, while PS4 is the original baseline.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam/Epic PC build. Record build, Broken Road DLC ownership, graphics settings, ultrawide/fps state, controller, accessibility settings, challenge modes, Horde Assault/Permadeath/Speedrun coverage, and whether PS5 Remastered or PS4 was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting PS5 features, DualSense behavior, or console performance.
secondary.why: PC remains the best capture route but PS5 is the current console remaster.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for original performance/history comparison.
secondary.why: PC/PS5 have better capture and update paths.

all_releases.fidelity: PC route with high settings, ultrawide/fps flexibility, and current DLC option.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 5 Remastered / Broken Road DLC on PC
all_releases.fidelity: Remastered/expanded modes and PC DLC route.
all_releases.reason: primary: include current mode/content state if owned.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is the fidelity route, but Broken Road DLC and PS5 Remastered features must be recorded for current completeness.
